items.title: Businesses grapple with the cost of customers 'wanting to pay by card'
items.summary: Customers still prefer to pay with cards, but a week after a ban on payment surcharges, small businesses are looking at how they will wear the cost of merchant fees.

items.title: Captains offered $US100,000 a month in the Strait of Hormuz
items.summary: Oil tanker captains in the Persian Gulf are being paid up to $US100,000 a month to navigate the Strait of Hormuz, industry insiders and maritime unions say.

aus.headline: Card Fees Hit Small Shops
aus.body: A week into the surcharge ban, small firms are weighing how to absorb card fees.
aus.why: Card fees can no longer be added on top as a surcharge at the till.

us.headline: Hormuz Pay Hits $US100,000
us.body: Gulf oil tanker captains are earning up to $US100,000 monthly to sail through Hormuz.
us.why: Getting oil tankers through the Gulf now comes with a steep wage bill.
